A '''servo control system''' was a part used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]].

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] needed a servo control system to fix his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was able to obtain one by either trading a [[fuel converter]] and a [[repulse booster]] to [[Barbo]] or an [[engine binder]] and a [[repulse booster]] to [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto]].

Qui-Gon could also obtain the servo control system by killing Barbo or Teemto and stealing it from them, but Anakin would then refuse to accept it.
